# Loopify

> Loopify is a music streaming application for listeners and artists.

## Public account pages

- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to an existing Loopify account.
- [Create an account](/register): Register a listener or artist account.
- [Reset a password](/forgot-password): Request a password reset.

## Authenticated features

Music discovery, playback, playlists, liked songs, profiles, and artist tools require an account.
Loopify does not publish public AI agents, MCP tools, or agent APIs.
